tone.target: sparse echoing goth clean with dubby reverb
tone.profile: sparse echoing goth clean with dubby reverb
tone.summary: A dark, echoing goth sound achieved using a clean pre-amp (Blues OD/Comp), followed by an AC30 TB or US Deluxe for warmth, paired with massive Plate Reverb and Digital Delay to create the signature sparse atmosphere.

rig.name: Bauhaus - Bela Lugosi's Dead - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum inherent in sparse recordings.
Provide a slight grit and warmth to the clean signal without adding distortion.
blocks.gap: The Blues OD is used for its gentle breakup, mimicking vintage tube preamps suitable for gothic rock textures.

alternatives.reason: For a smoother, more sustained clean tone.

blocks.purpose: Keep the signal clean and transparent to maintain the sparse atmosphere.

blocks.gap: The AC30 TB is ideal for clean, articulate single-note leads and atmospheric textures.
